## Summary

Describe what this change does and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or cleanup
- [ ] CI or tooling

## Related issues

Link any related issues, for example `Closes #123`.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `cargo fmt --all -- --check`.
- [ ] I ran `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- [ ] I ran `cargo test --workspace`.
- [ ] I updated the relevant docs under `docs/` if behavior changed.
- [ ] I wrote clear commit messages.

## Notes for reviewers

Anything that helps review the change, such as a migration note or a design
trade-off.
